svg.title: Short-term loudness of Clichê
svg.desc: Short-term loudness of the mix stays within a 1.2 LU band. The melody runs just under the mix, the bass 7 to 9 LU below it, and the countermelody 14 to 22 LU below while it plays.
svg.text: Short-term loudness shows when each part plays
Clichê, 3 s windows every 100 ms · band: the mix's 10th to 95th percentile, LRA 1.2 LU
